body.message: Following up again.We have provided all required details and confirmed the account earlier today.As of now, there is still no confirmation that the transfer has been initiated.Please note that this matter is already under review with DET, and we will be updating the case to reflect the continued delay in processing the refund.At this stage, there are no outstanding items from our side, and no valid justification for any deductions.We expect confirmation that the FULL refund of AED 17,675 has been initiated today.Kindly confirm immediately and share the payment confirmation.This delay is not acceptable.We have fully cooperated and there is no valid reason to withhold or delay the refund.If the transfer is not initiated today, we will proceed with further escalation through DET and formally document the continued non-payment.We still prefer to resolve this today.Please confirm once the transfer has been initiated.Best regards,M KOn 7 Apr 2026, at 10:01, Mikhail Kantsavenka <gomelmike@gmail.com> wrote:﻿Hello,Following up again.All required details have already been provided and confirmed, and there are no remaining blockers for the transfer.We are still awaiting confirmation that the full amount of AED 17,675 has been processed.Kindly confirm the status of the payment and whether the transfer has been initiated today.This matter is already under review with DET, and we expect it to be resolved without further delay.Thank you.Best regards,M KOn 6 Apr 2026, at 17:53, Mikhail Kantsavenka <gomelmike@gmail.com> wrote:﻿Hello,Please proceed with the refund using the bank details already provided.The account is authorized to receive the funds, and there are no remaining issues preventing the transfer.Kindly proceed without delay and confirm once the payment has been initiated today.Thank you.Best regards,M KOn 6 Apr 2026, at 16:56, Chahana | fäm Living <deposit@famliving.com> wrote:﻿Hello Kamola,To confirm the deposit refund, we have received the bank details; however, the name provided differs from the booking name. The name we received is Mikhail Kantsavenka.Kindly confirm if we should proceed with the refund to this account.Chahana T.On Mon, Apr 6, 2026 11:07 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Following up.We are still awaiting confirmation of the full refund of AED 17,675 today.Please confirm the transfer status.Best regards,M KOn Mon, Apr 6, 2026 10:01 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Dear Chahana,We strongly disagree with your position.1. The alleged “bedbug issue” was raised only after checkout and is not supported by any jointly signed inspection report. Furthermore, pest issues were reported during the stay and are already documented.2. The provided invoice does not establish tenant liability and cannot justify any deduction. No evidence has been provided that the issue was caused by us.3. The claimed deduction for “items left in the apartment” is also unsupported. No signed inventory, report, or agreed deduction has been presented.4. As previously stated, no valid justification has been provided for any deductions.The full amount of AED 17,675 has already been formally claimed and submitted in the DET complaint.Given the above, we do not accept any deductions and expect the full amount to be refunded immediately.Please confirm that the remaining balance will be transferred without delay.Failing this, the matter will continue to be pursued through DET and other appropriate channels.Regards,  MikhailBest regards,M KOn Mon, Apr 6, 2026 9:05 AM, Chahana T. wrote:Hello Mikhail,Thank you for your message.As we mentioned previously, a deduction was applied for the removal of items left in the apartment. Additionally, during the inspection carried out after your checkout, the team identified a bedbug issue. The inspection was documented, and please find attached the receipt for the bedbug treatment conducted.Based on this, the refund has been processed accordingly, and the amount you will be receiving has been clearly stated.We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this matter.Kind regards,Chahana T.On Mon, Apr 6, 2026 4:25 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Hi,Kind but urgent request that the full amount of AED 17,675 has already been formally submitted in the DET complaint.No valid justification has been provided for any deduction.Therefore, we expect the full amount to be refunded today.Kindly confirm that AED 17,675 will be transferred today and provide confirmation once initiated.Best regards,M KOn Fri, Apr 3, 2026 12:54 PM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Hi,Once again. Thank you for your message.Please note that the agreed and claimed amounts have already been formally submitted to DET, including the full security deposit of AED 5,000, bringing the total to AED 17,675.No valid justification, signed inspection report, or agreed deductions have been provided to support any reduction of the deposit.Therefore, we expect the full amount as claimed to be refunded.Kindly confirm that the total refund of AED 17,675 will be processed.Thank you.Best regards,M KOn Fri, Apr 3, 2026 6:31 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Hi,Thank you for the update.However, the security deposit was AED 5,000, and no valid justification or signed inspection report indicating any damages has been provided.As previously stated, no damages were reported at checkout, and no deductions were agreed.Therefore, we expect the full security deposit of AED 5,000 to be refunded.Please provide a detailed breakdown and supporting documentation for the AED 1,400 deduction, or proceed with the full refund.Please, nothe that  any deduction is unjustified and will be formally disputed.Please confirm that the full amount of AED 17,675 will be transferred today.If not resolved promptly, this matter will be escalated further through DET and formal dispute channels.On Fri, Apr 3, 2026 at 11:10 AM Chahana | fäm Living <deposit@famliving.com> wrote:On Fri, Apr 3, 2026 6:10 AM, Chahana T. wrote:Hello Mikhail,Thank you for your message. The rent for the period will be AED 12,675, and the security deposit is AED 3,600. The total amount to be refunded will therefore be AED 16,275.Please let us know if you need any further clarification.Best regards,Chahana T.On Fri, Apr 3, 2026 5:04 AM, gomelmike@gmail.com wrote:Dear Chahana,Just to confirm, the total refund amount is AED 17,675 (AED 12,675 for unused nights + AED 5,000 security deposit).Please confirm that the full amount will be transferred.Best regards,M KOn Thu, Apr 2, 2026 5:52 PM, Chahana T. wrote:Dear Mikhail,We have received the details and we are proceeding it Kind regards,Tharushi
